stratum.purpose: Whole-solution over-engineering and requirement-justified near-miss cases for the self-sufficient solution-simplicity lens. Populated and sourced from adjudicated human review, with the recorded disposition as the first adjudication. NO executable oracle exists for this subject: 'over-engineered' and 'requirement-justified' are design judgements a runnable check cannot decide. Every case therefore records adjudication.second: owner_required and a concrete recommended disposition for the owner to confirm or overturn. NOT scored: every expectation is uncalibrated and no case has been run through any runtime, per the owner-settled three-way grading method - a scored case is never calibrated on its own prose, and a grader miss must surface as referred rather than a silent reviewer-miss.
